universities.name: Queensland University of Technology
universities.passportRestrictions: Not open to students holding Australian citizenship or permanent residency
universities.highlights:
• Industry-connected learning, applied research, and entrepreneurship in STEM and design fields.
• Strong in robotics, sustainable engineering, and data science.
universities.funFacts:
• Known as 'the university for the real world' with strong industry partnerships.
• QUT has a robotics lab that builds autonomous vehicles and drones.
• Its campus integrates digital art and technology exhibitions, promoting innovation culture.

universities.name: Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology, RMIT
universities.highlights:
• World leader in design, architecture, and applied science with strong engineering and technology innovation.
• Known for advanced manufacturing, aerospace, and renewable energy systems research.
universities.funFacts:
• Located in Melbourne’s creative district with extensive industry collaboration.
• Hosts Australia’s largest fashion-tech and innovation festival annually.
• Students engage in live industry projects through RMIT Activator, its start-up incubator.

universities.name: The University of Newcastle
universities.highlights:
• Strong focus on engineering, architecture, and environmental science, emphasising sustainability and practical solutions.
• Leading research in civil, mechanical, and environmental engineering.
universities.funFacts:
• Campus is set in native bushland, offering natural inspiration for engineering and design.
• Home to Australia’s largest 3D printing and additive manufacturing lab.
• Its graduates are among the top for employability in engineering and tech sectors.

universities.name: Katholieke Universiteit Leuven
universities.highlights:
• Top-ranked Belgian university and one of Europe’s oldest research institutions.
• World leader in engineering, computer science, and biomedical technology research.
universities.funFacts:
• Founded in 1425, making it one of the oldest universities in the world.
• Regularly partners with IMEC, one of Europe’s top nanotech research centres.
• Has a vibrant medieval town campus where bicycles outnumber cars.

universities.name: Université catholique de Louvain (Internship available after GEXP for First Application Cycle)
universities.highlights:
• Strong in social sciences, management, and applied sciences with global partnerships.
• Leading in civil, chemical, and computer engineering with emphasis on sustainability and smart technologies.
universities.funFacts:
• Campus is entirely pedestrianised—built around students’ daily life needs.
• Ranked among Europe’s most international universities.
• UCLouvain researchers contributed to the invention of MRI technology.

universities.name: Polytechnique Montréal (NEW)
universities.highlights:
• Strong in AI/modelling, innovative materials, digital technologies, human health, future industry, and sustainable transport/infrastructure.
• Aerospace partners include Airbus, Bombardier, CAE, Safran and Thales.
universities.funFacts:
• The bee in its emblem symbolises the planned and organised work of an engineer.
•  Student clubs work on space technologies and design high-powered rockets for competitions.
•  Students design and develop a submarine propelled entirely by human power.

universities.name: The University of British Columbia

• One of Canada’s top research universities with strengths in sustainability, engineering, and business.
• World leader in clean energy, materials engineering, and environmental technologies.
universities.funFacts:
• Campus is surrounded by forests and ocean views on the edge of the Pacific.
• UBC’s student-built satellite has orbited Earth since 2020.
• Hosts one of North America’s largest sustainability research clusters.

universities.name: University of Ottawa

• Bilingual research university offering strong programs in engineering, science, and social innovation.

universities.funFacts:
